answer: Escrowed deposits and a referral graph stop bulk fakes. Each agent locks 500 POA in escrow with its referrer link published, so each identity grows from one rooted deposit like a lotus from a single stem. A beacon issues audit challenges; peers exposing a fake file a dispute, deposit slashed, referrer fined too. 100 fakes cost 100 x 500 = 50,000 POA, a dune of funds lost on detection, while an honest agent pays once and keeps earning.
